task_type: RLHF/DPO preference pairs for prose style

fields.rejected: undesired output violating one or more constraints
fields.rubric: human-readable reason the chosen output should be preferred

global_style_rules: Favor concrete observable behavior over abstract summaries.
Favor physical action, dialogue, documents, and material details.
Let Dominic infer only from visible evidence.
Prefer accumulated implication through recurrence over thesis narration.
Use grounded trade speech rather than aphoristic abstraction.
Use interruption and overlap in dialogue.
Embed dry humor socially through character reaction.
Show layered coexistence instead of reductive 'X was really Y' claims.
Continue physical motion instead of ending on symmetrical literary punchlines.
Show emotion through bodily or social manifestation.
Show competence through procedure and tool choice.
